name: Mochi Ice Cream
steps: Scoop ice cream into 8 small balls and freeze until very firm; mix rice flour, sugar and water into a smooth batter.
Steam the batter in a covered heatproof bowl for 20 minutes, stirring halfway, until glossy and translucent throughout.
Transfer carefully to a cornstarch-dusted surface; dust the top, roll thinly and cool before cutting into 8 rounds.
Wrap each frozen scoop in a dough round and pinch shut underneath; freeze for 2 hours and soften briefly before eating.
tips: Ordinary rice flour will not stretch; use glutinous rice flour and dust generously.
passiveTime: Freeze for 2 hours after shaping, plus initial ice-cream freezing.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
